home.title: Speed Enforcement Unit
home.lead: Official unit guide for authorized SEU members. Follow all policies exactly as written.
home.warning: Leaking this guide will result in an immediate blacklist.

uniforms: CHP | SEU Officer — Every SEU member
CHP | SEU Command — Board of Commanders
equipment.weaponNote: All weapon regulations follow your rank. Failure results in an infraction.

vehicles.highCommand: Any vehicle. Bypasses certifications and regulations.
vehicles.misc: 2022 Bullhorn Determinator SFP Fury — Must be EVOC certified and trained in CHP.
vehicles.undercover: AC+ may use undercover vehicles without police identifiers for covert approaches.

uof.intro: Use of force is heavily enforced. De-escalate properly and calmly at all times.
rules: Aiming your gun at an unarmed civilian or another officer at any time results in an infraction.
Firing when there is no threat results in an infraction.
Shooting or killing a civilian with no apparent threat results in termination from the division.
Mag-dumping a corpse results in an infraction.

policies.quotaIntro: Officers must hit weekly shift quota to remain active and eligible for promotion. Quotas are checked Friday evenings.
policies.missed: Each miss = 1 strike. Miss 3 times in a row without LOA = removal from the division. Always check announcements for current quota.
policies.promo: Eligible by hitting weekly quota, consistency, and performance. High Rank+ promotions consider additional factors beyond shift time.
policies.loa: Request Leave of Absence up to 3 weeks. Request extensions via ticket to HR. Notify HR before LOA ends if you still cannot play — or risk infraction.

retirement.text: When retiring, you may reinstate within two months (1× demotion). If you reinstate after one month, re-training is required. Some certifications are not regained if you are not the required rank.
